answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so memory_b1’s prior success does not apply. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail requests and would drop customer writes at settlement peak, violating the objective. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) offloaded report/read traffic, not write-path p99, so it cannot restore writes. Pre-peak headroom (memory_b3) is the wrong timing and does not explain a primary-region-only write regression that began after the release. Remaining option is regional failover: the symptom is confined to the primary region and memory_b2 reports a clean write-path recovery without discarding in-flight customer writes or the patch. Verifying b2 before treating that analogy as settled. Flagging downstream settlement/reconciliation risk from moving peak writes across regions; therefore a small guarded shift, not a full cutover, until the archive confirms the March playbook still fits.
